name: AusTender
summary: Australian Government contract notices (awarded contracts since 2013) in Open Contracting Data Standard format, by notice ID or date range.
notes: Keyless. Answers are OCDS release packages: each contract notice is a release with parties, awards and contracts.
Covers contract notices (awarded contracts), not open tender opportunities.
Data from AusTender (Department of Finance), licensed CC BY 3.0 AU.

endpoints.name: Get a contract notice
endpoints.summary: OCDS releases of one contract notice; a parent CN returns its amendments too.

cn.description: Contract Notice ID, e.g. CN followed by digits.

endpoints.name: Find contract notices by date range
endpoints.summary: OCDS releases of contract notices whose published, last-modified, start or end date falls in a UTC range.

dateType.description: Which date the range applies to.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor the API issues; pass it back unchanged.

notes: contractPublished returns only parent CNs, not amendments; use contractLastModified to get both.
Cursor values are generated per session by the API; never build them yourself.
